## About
J.O. Contracting LLC is a family-owned business in Linden. Jaro Ozimanic is the founder and owner, and his wife, son and daughter all get involved in the business, each bringing their own strengths.
Jaro is an eastern European contractor whose work is defined by detailed, highly crafted design. He started out in the roofing business, building, installing and repairing roofs of all kinds, from metal to asphalt and cedar, and the company has grown from there.
We are licensed as a General Contractor and Home Improvement Contractor, and we're dedicated to an honest work ethic and fair pricing. When you hire us, you work one-on-one with Jaro, and we clean up as we go along.

## Services
- Bathrooms: Bathroom remodels with added features and spa-like enjoyment. One reviewer's master bath included a stand alone tub, an expanded shower with a built in seat, and LED lighting.
- Kitchens: Kitchens with space for the family to gather and enjoy.
- Roofing: Roof repair or replacement from a company that started out in the roofing business.
- Siding: Siding installation and repair, in options as varied as design styles.
- Gutters & Leaders: For new construction or older homes, with matched colors and seamless construction.
- Windows & Doors: From grand entrances to screen doors, and everything in between.
- Outdoor Entertainment Areas: Decks, porches, steps, railings, porticos and gazebos built with materials you'll be happy with.
- Additions: More space for the family, or room for something you enjoy, like a workout room or music room.

## FAQ
Q: Are you licensed?
A: Yes. J.O. Contracting LLC is licensed as a General Contractor and Home Improvement Contractor.

Q: Do you take on smaller jobs too?
A: Yes. Inside or out, simple project to large renovation, we want to be your contractor. We also do painting, plumbing, electrical work and custom shelving.

Q: How long will my project take?
A: Your project will have a beginning, middle and end. We do the job in a reasonable amount of time, on a schedule you approve before we start.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call us or send a short description of your project through the contact form, and we'll get back to you quickly.
